section_order_evidence: 2MBYTE.OBJ and every Runtime Library 3.3 module declare sections in this order; the certified library sections appear in the image in the same order

regions.name: leading module
evidence: payload starts at the header load address 0x80010000
retail .text calls (jal) ['0x80010000', '0x80010170']: code, with its tables, ahead of the first string referenced by matched code at 0x800101e0
not .text: PSYLINK concatenates same-named sections and .text starts at 0x8001380c; its section name (.rdata or an earlier-ordered section) is not evidenced

regions.name: .rdata
evidence: first string referenced by matched code at 0x800101e0, before .text
last library .rdata PRNT ends at 0x8001380c: certified Runtime Library 3.3 section (reports/runtime_data.json)
start is the leading module's start or its end, depending on that module's section

regions.name: .text
evidence: first matched function at 0x8001380c directly follows the library .rdata end
last certified library text module C112 ends at 0x8006a578
first global referenced by matched code above it is 0x8006a578
observed (not certifying) retail operand pairs naming 0x8006a578 as data: ['0x80014a74']

regions.name: .data
evidence: library .data S_RMP..CTYPE lie in [0x80074164, 0x8008cd71): certified Runtime Library 3.3 section (reports/runtime_data.json)
end is sectstart(.sdata) = 0x8008cd74 from 2MBYTE.OBJ (also its $gp)

regions.name: .sdata
evidence: sectstart(.sdata) = 0x8008cd74 and sectstart(.sbss) = 0x8008d088, retail operands of 2MBYTE.OBJ at 0x800588bc
library .sdata ends at 0x8008d087 (alignment to 0x8008d088)

regions.name: .sbss
evidence: start: sectstart(.sbss), the startup zero-clear start
last evidenced library .sbss section ends at 0x8008d318
first evidenced library .bss section starts at 0x8008f6ec
the payload file carries the first 1912 bytes of .sbss as zeros (payload rounded to 0x800 at 0x8008d800)

regions.name: .bss
evidence: library .bss sections evidenced in [0x8008f6ec, 0x8009603c)
the lowest library COMMON symbol is at 0x8009603c

regions.name: COMMON
evidence: COMMON (XBSS) symbols allocated by the linker after the .bss sections
end is sectend(.bss) = 0x800a1958 (zero-clear end and heap base)
